title: contao/newsletter-bundle: Contao newsletter custom actions bypass channel-scoped authorization (CVE-2026-104881)
description: A vulnerability in contao/newsletter-bundle allows a channel-scoped newsletter editor to bypass channel-scoped authorization. This enables unauthorized injection, mass mailing, and in some versions, deletion or denylisting of recipients in channels they should not have access to. The flaw arises because custom newsletter actions bypass the usual per-record permission checks, relying only on module-level access control.
